title: "Herbaria"

```{r}
#| echo: false
source("R/map.R")
melanobs_map(show = "herbaria")
h <- read_herbaria()
knitr::kable(data.frame(h$code, paste0("[", h$name, "](herbaria/", h$slug, ".qmd)"),
                        h$city, h$country),
             col.names = c("Code", "Name", "City", "Country"))
```
